M25-0150-P01 — Counterevidence: A fresh independently transcribed native rational calculation agrees with the frozen reviewer evidence and all201 supplied coefficients after all three changes; restoring the exponent alone leaves34 discrepancies. This is not a new fullerene enumeration. The restricted Example3.27 and n=5000 example avoid the changed positive indices and survive.

M25-0150-P02 — Counterevidence: The actual root-lattice forms A2,D4,E6,E8 have quadratic levels3,2,3,1, respectively. Taking negatives, primitive complements and even-overlattice isotropic subquotients preserves a dividing quadratic level. The decorated argument sums components of the original even lattice; it need not declare the partially saturated module even. These facts preserve the intended application levels.

M25-0150-P03 — Counterevidence: Table2 already distinguishes the two C2 profiles and marks automatic symmetry enlargements; Example3.30 itself uses the different collision branches. Thus the evidence supports a local refinement, not failure of the detailed rational counting conversion.
M25-0150-P04 — Counterevidence: The table and later half-triangle convention already give the correct values; no propagated final counting error is established.

M25-0150-P05 — Counterevidence: The correction changes a constant, while the conversion already permits additive constants and Omega includes1. No additional positive-coefficient count failure follows. A regularized noncompact weight2 constant requires its own prescription.
M25-0150-P06 — Counterevidence: The preceding product, final q1 numerator and q2 mass697/40310784 agree with the final weight9 A,B. The evidence does not refute those final coefficients.

M25-0150-P07 — Counterevidence: A properly regularized lift can still yield the stated weight2 quasimodular count. After the y prefactor, its leading logarithmic divergence may be tau-independent and disappear upon a justified differentiation. The paper acknowledges a nonholomorphic correction. No counterexample to the intended regularized conclusion is established.

Replace E2(q^9) coefficient1/64 with1/18.

Use the quadratic discriminant level N(gamma,gamma)/2 integral for all gamma.

Track A2,D4,E6,E8 discriminant quadratic forms and isotropic subquotients in the application.

State strata by ramification action/quotient data.

Exclude automatic symmetry enlargements when claiming an exact stratum.

Use normalization with marked collision data and sum inverse-stabilizer masses over finite fibres.

Define r as half the minimum triangle count.

Insert (-1)^d in the convergent volume formula.

Replace exponent12 by11 in the single middle denominator.

Specify a truncated or regularized lift and subtraction convention.
